edition: Returns by year: calendar 1928–2025, as retrieved

source_notes.us_stocks: S&P 500 annual nominal total return including dividends; pre-1957 backfilled index history.
source_notes.us_bonds: Annual nominal total return of reconstructed constant-maturity 10-year US Treasury, including coupon and price changes; not an aggregate-bond index or ETF.
source_notes.usd_cash: Annual 3-month Treasury-bill rate proxy; provider uses annual average rates. Not a bank deposit or money-market-fund return series.
source_notes.us_cpi: Annual US CPI inflation rate from provider worksheet.
source_notes.us_home: US home-price appreciation from provider Shiller/Case-Shiller history; excludes rent, modeled separately.

coverage_note: Only the five US joint annual series are historical. China CPI, medical cost growth, FX, fixed distribution yields and property-specific adjustments remain configuration assumptions.

us_cpi_source.convention: December CPI / preceding December CPI - 1; not seasonally adjusted

status: Imported, pending independent raw-cell/source acceptance; does not verify legal rules
